card.name: Partway through rare or foreign words
card.fires_on: Partway through rare, archaic or foreign-looking words and names in dictionary or encyclopedia-style text, such as the 'l' in interlaced, 'err' in Viverridae, or 'oin' in Poincaré. It sometimes fires on a verb just before its participle.

modes.label: Split rare words
modes.description: A piece in the middle of an old or unusual word where the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: Taxonomic and foreign names
modes.description: The middle of Latin family names and accented European proper names.

modes.label: Verb before participle
modes.description: A word like 'be' or 'carefully' that is expected to be followed by a past-participle verb.
modes.example: timely Notice will<< be>> taken of them.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a word with an ending piece and away from common verb forms like utilise and organise.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of rare, old or foreign words and names, as in a dictionary entry.
